workflow_hints: Immunoprecipitated proteins were washed, and eluted with 0.2 M glycine pH 2.0. Eluted proteins were precipitated with acetone and digested with trypsin.

Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: The experiment is a classic AP-MS (Affinity Purification Mass Spectrometry) using immunoprecipitation of MYC/MYCN. While the instrument is an Orbitrap Exploris 480, the use of 'Full mass spectrometry resolutions' and the general workflow for interactome identification strongly indicates DDA. Quantification was performed via spectrum counting (per PRIDE metadata) and fold-change analysis.

cell_types: MYC-amplified small cell lung carcinoma NCI-H2171 cells
scope: Total cellular proteins extracted from Kelly and NCI-H2171 cells were subjected to immunoprecipitation (IP) using MYCN and MYC antibodies.
